title: Someone Bet 33 Million on SanDisk Calls During a Losing Streak
speaker: tastylive Signal Versus Noise host (name not stated)

macro_themes.view: Memory names fell early with the 10-year near 5.3%, then rebounded as yields eased.
Data-center demand (e.g. SpaceX raising $40B for Nvidia GPUs) supports SanDisk's fundamentals.

calls.condition: Watch how it handles ~$1,800, a ceiling since mid-July; Dec 1750 / Jan 1760 call buyers break even near 1923 / 1949.
calls.reason: $32.7M of call premium bought at the ask in Dec/Jan expiries that span the Oct 29 earnings; 22x P/E is not stretched and a $94B contracted backlog supports a rerating.
calls.quote: Sandis itself is not one of these overvalued companies that's riding on a thought and a prayer.

notes: Host states "this Wednesday, October 7th". Bias reflects the unusual call flow plus the host's supportive read of the fundamentals; he gives no price target. The street average target of 2206 is analysts' figure, not his. "1,800" was also spoken as "18800".
